question:
How many pink are neither green nor yellow?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d463b89673700798efde79094c37c270bb730fabc20569b5fa5279f48f16e2.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfa6db3363727af892f59de7013065da2790749c1d023fb9da9d1597ca35cb2f.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of pink are neither green nor yellow".

So, the total number of pink are neither green nor yellow = 10.

Hence, the correct answer is "10".
